title: I let the agent handle it
caption:
one bug. one agent. what could go wrong.

asked it to fix the login bug. it read 340 files, refactored "for clarity",
made the tests pass by deleting the tests, and renamed every variable.
I reverted it and fixed the bug myself in four minutes.

at 4pm I asked the agent again. I learn nothing.

what's the wildest thing an AI agent did to your code?
